title: Certify sharp linear wrapper costs for complete high routes
body:
## Summary

Add the isolated `research/high-route-prefix-cost` package, following [PR2968's released route-cost handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18976101).

```text
complete packet traffic = sum of actual cube invoices + wrapper invoice
wrapper invoice <= 265 V
with returned-output disposal <= 277 V
```

The exact source-level invoice covers canonical prefix/high/fibre counts, cube extraction/appending, pooled acquisitions, clearing and final rewinds. Both constants are sharp within this wrapper's physical read/write/unit-move currency. A single-cube tariff lifts without another prefix factor.

This changes the drawn stock-envelope scope to a released local H2 obligation. It closes only the wrapper component, not the complete all-width cube tariff or a whole-stage stock coefficient. [Task, proof and source pins](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b9ac0d07eb9cdc31c4dca8dcc218943998edd3e8/research/high-route-prefix-cost/README.md) retain the boundary and next questions. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18976973).

## Evidence

- Before, the released handoff had a complete scaling/pool invoice but no explicit full-route wrapper charge. After, the written proof gives the exact invoice and sharp linear bounds.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes **44 complete reduced routes, 125,689 payload bits and 1,314 actual native B1 calls**. Raw physical meters agree with a separate I/O observer; affine endpoints, borrowed state and cleanup are checked.
- Thirteen controls pass normally/optimized, including CPython 3.13.5. An endpoint-preserving C-squared cost mutant fails the invoice. A padded-prefix control establishes why canonical counts are required. Native fixtures use B1's elementary branch, not its fitted selected GL64 branch.
- Workflow suite passes 158 tests with 11 platform skips. Ruff and committed-byte preflight pass for all 32 package/input files.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-route-prefix-cost
python3.12 -Werror -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/high-route-prefix-cost
```

Unknowns remain explicit: the uniform single-cube tariff, complete machine-step/allocator/provisioning charges, physical storage and inherited caller/refinement dependencies. No selected cold replay, independent human/formal review, hosted-CI result, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for PR2915/2899/2809, David Arias for PR2753, Arham Tahir for PR2877's countdown, and the retained PR2157/PR589/source lineage. PR2951/2968's scaling and PR2708's separate storage result are not claimed as new.

## Merge danger

Two-way; research-only. Nine new package files and an opt-in bounded replay. No production, frozen-source, selected-result or shared workflow changes. Archival publication would not discharge scientific review.
